# Finger Hole Knife Guide

> Independent buyer's guide to a stainless chef knife with a hole in the blade for the index finger (sold by its seller through a ClickBank checkout). We are not the seller and have not tested the knife; facts come from the seller's page and public buyer comments. Links to the seller are paid affiliate links.

Prices on the seller's page on 2026-11-10: 1 knife $49.99, 2 knives $69.98, 4 knives $99.96. 60-day guarantee from the seller. Ships to US addresses.
